plan.title: BOQ manual awarding is vendor-level only

steps.note: Open the supplied existing closed BOQ project; do not create a replacement.
Assert the comparison grid renders with line items and bidding vendors.
Enter the manual awarding screen without allocating a vendor.
Check that the vendor-awarding action described by the case is offered.
Assert the prohibited bulk-selection label is absent.
Record the vendor columns and line controls for inspection; this does not assert the absence of individual-line selection.
